lines.text: Many learners say: I did a mistake in my homework.
Better: I made a mistake in my homework.
Makes! Everyone makes a mistake sometimes.

data.wrong: I did a mistake in my homework.
data.right: I made a mistake in my homework.
data.memory: I made a mistake in my homework.

native.tip: Türkçede “hata yapmak” deriz; “yapmak” burada İngilizcede “do” değil “make” olur: “I made a mistake in my homework.”
native.caption: “I did a mistake in my homework” mi diyorsun? 😅 Türkçedeki “hata yapmak” İngilizcede “make a mistake” olur, “do” gelmez. Doğrusu “I made a mistake in my homework.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “makes”. “Mistake” ile “make” kullanılır. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: Use “make,” not “do”: “I made a mistake in my homework.”
en.caption: Do you say “I did a mistake in my homework”? 😅 In English we say “make a mistake,” not “do a mistake.” The right sentence is “I made a mistake in my homework.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
